QF.id: Securities Types Features and Asset Allocation Concepts_21

question.text: Investment in physical commodities like gold involves which of the following additional costs compared to equity and debt securities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Unlike equity and debt securities, investment in physical forms of commodities involves storage and insurance costs. These can be high enough to make physical commodity investment impractical for ordinary investors. The Trap: Brokerage (option B) applies broadly to buying and selling securities, not uniquely to commodities. Demat charges (option C) apply to securities held in dematerialised form. SEBI does not levy annual fees on investors (option D). Note: Storage and insurance costs are the distinguishing extra burden of holding physical commodities versus financial securities.
